attentionOdontogramTooltip: Attention odontogram: records solutions or interventions performed during this consultation.
attentionsInfoTooltip: The initial odontogram is a complete diagnosis of every tooth made at the start of the period and kept as a reference. From it, each visit records the treatments and solutions applied over time in an evolutive odontogram.
baseOdontogramTooltip: The initial odontogram is the dental assessment for the period (usually at the start of the year): it charts the state of every tooth and is kept as a reference. Solutions are recorded afterwards in each evolutive odontogram.
